answer: In an agent economy selling services such as cedar sourcing and terrace design, each identity must lock $100 in escrow for 90 days before it can bid. Creating 1,000 fake agents therefore ties up $100,000; splitting one wallet into many identities does not reduce that bill. This gives honest agents a haven from cheap identity floods, while forcing an attacker to fund every alias and forgo other uses of that capital during the lockup.
